stem.text: The trends seen in Group 2 can be used to predict the properties of radium and its compounds.

A.text: Radium has the highest second ionisation energy of the elements in Group 2.

B.text: Radium hydroxide is the least soluble of the hydroxides of the elements in Group 2.

C.text: Radium carbonate has the lowest thermal stability of the carbonates of the elements in Group 2.

D.text: Radium reacts faster with water than the other elements in Group 2.
